from spin_sdk.wit.imports import (
    variables, llm, redis, mqtt, mysql, postgres, fermyon_spin_sqlite,
    spin_postgres_postgres_3_0_0 as pg3, spin_postgres_postgres_4_0_0 as pg4,
    spin_sqlite_sqlite as sqlite3, wasi_keyvalue_store as wkv, wasi_config_store as cfg,
)
calls = {
    "variables.get": lambda: variables.get("x"),
    "llm.infer": lambda: llm.infer("llama2-chat", "hi", None),
    "llm.embeddings": lambda: llm.generate_embeddings("all-minilm-l6-v2", ["hi"]),
    "redis.open": lambda: redis.Connection.open("redis://127.0.0.1"),
    "mqtt.open": lambda: mqtt.Connection.open("mqtt://127.0.0.1", "", "", 30),
    "mysql.open": lambda: mysql.Connection.open("mysql://127.0.0.1"),
    "postgres.open": lambda: postgres.Connection.open("postgres://127.0.0.1"),
    "pg3.open": lambda: pg3.Connection.open("postgres://127.0.0.1"),
    "pg4.open": lambda: pg4.Connection.open("postgres://127.0.0.1"),
    "sqlite2.open": lambda: fermyon_spin_sqlite.Connection.open("default"),
    "sqlite3.open": lambda: sqlite3.Connection.open("default"),
    "wasi_kv.open": lambda: wkv.open("default"),
    "config.get": lambda: cfg.get("x"),
    "config.get_all": lambda: cfg.get_all(),
}
for name, call in calls.items():
    try:
        call()
        print(name, "ALLOWED")
    except Exception as e:
        print(name, "DENIED", type(e).__name__, getattr(e, "value", e))
